title: 第十三章 种不出东西了第十四章 龙鳞
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: 玄稷好心的给翻译。
“大胖赏你的，让你以后听它差遣，它不会亏待你的。”
大胖狂点头。
它又叼来三粒果仁，狗眼有深意地看向慕狱手上的储物戒。
小主人有空间自己没有，它知道那个也能装东西。
这会儿不用玄稷再翻译了，慕狱也知道那狗是什么意思了。
“就那点想换我的储物戒？”
大胖狠狠心，又叼来两粒，一共五粒了，要是不行就算了。
慕狱见好就收。
“成交！”
他自然不可能给自己的储物戒，但他还有其他的储物袋，都是以前杀人夺宝抢来的。
拿出来一个。
“你没有手指戴不了戒指，这个储物袋可以给你挂脖子上，也能装很多东西。”
大胖不在意是戒指还是袋子，只要能给它一个装东西的就行。
示意慕狱赶紧给戴上。
慕狱为了以后能蹭到更多的好东西，还专门用一根自己不用的魔器链子系的。
大胖都滴血认主了，见链子自动缩小成合适的圈很是满意。
让小主人把辣椒给它自己装着。
说到辣椒玄稷才想起来，辣椒才种一半呢。
过来一看，只见长大一倍还开了满树桃花的树下，莲花脸色干瘪的躺着，进气少，出气多。
“呀，莲花，你怎么了？”
“公主～救命～”
莲花也不知道啊，她只是把小公主的洗脸水拿来浇树，谁知道刚浇完浑身魔气就被抽空，直接软倒在地爬不起来。
她以为自己死了才会被发现呢。
换了衣服出来的范沐禾，发现那桃树净化范围已经达到方圆二十米，直接把人摄取过来。
看着玄稷道：“给她吃几粒狗尾巴草。”
莲花荷花对自己都很好，玄稷毫不心疼拿出来一把喂给莲花。
莲花修为低，吃了几粒就恢复过来，心有余悸。
“小公主种出来的东西怎么都那么恐怖？”
玄稷见莲花没事了，这也才发现之前种的种子长成了一棵小树，好像不能吃。
“这是什么树呀？”
荷花下意识回：“桃树。”
“哇，我知道！
我见过周欣甜吃桃子，桃子的味道闻起来可香拉！”
玄稷这话让范沐禾几人，听的心里都有一种酸酸的感觉。
这孩子以前过的到底是什么苦日子？
content_en:
Xuan Ji kindly translated.
"Big Fatty rewarded you so that you can obey its orders in the future. It will not treat you badly."
The fat man nodded.
It picked up three more nuts and looked at the storage ring in Mu Yu's hand thoughtfully.
The little master has space that he doesn’t have, and he knows it can hold things.
Now there is no need for Xuanji to translate, Mu Yu also knows what the dog means.
"That's all you want to exchange for my storage ring?"
The fat man was so cruel that he took two more pills, making a total of five pills. If it didn't work, forget it.
Mu Yu accepted it as soon as it was good.
"Deal!"
Naturally, it was impossible for him to give his own storage ring, but he also had other storage bags, all of which were stolen from previous murders and treasure hunts.
Take one out.
"You can't wear a ring without fingers. This storage bag can be hung around your neck and can hold a lot of things."
Big Fat doesn't care if it's a ring or a bag, as long as it has a place to hold things.
He signaled to Mu Yu to put it on quickly.
In order to get more good things in the future, Mu Yu even tied it with a magic weapon chain that he didn't use.
The big fat man recognized his master with blood, and was very satisfied to see the chain automatically shrink into a suitable circle.
Let the little master pack the chili for himself.
When I mentioned Chili Xuanji, I remembered that the chili peppers were only half planted.
When I came over to take a look, I saw a lotus lying under a tree that had doubled in size and was full of peach blossoms, with a shriveled face, less air coming in and more air coming out.
"Hey, Lotus, what's wrong with you?"
"Princess~Help~"
Lianhua didn't know either. She just used the little princess's washing water to water the tree. Who knew that just after watering the tree, the demonic energy was drained from her body, and she fell to the ground and couldn't get up.
She thought she would be discovered only after she died.
Fan Muhe came out after changing his clothes and found that the peach tree's purification range had reached a radius of twenty meters, and it could directly ingest people.
He looked at Xuan Ji and said, "Give her a few grains of dogtail grass."
Lotus and Lotus were very good to him, so Xuan Ji took out a handful and fed it to Lotus without feeling any distress.
Lian Hua's cultivation level was low and he recovered after taking a few pills, but still had lingering fears.
"Why are the things grown by the little princess so scary?"
When Xuanji saw that the lotus was fine, he discovered that the seeds he had planted had grown into a small tree and seemed inedible.
"What kind of tree is this?"
Lotus subconsciously replied: "Peach tree."
"Wow, I know!
I have seen Zhou Xintian eating peaches, and the peaches smell delicious! "
Xuan Ji's words made Fan Muhe and others feel a sour feeling in their hearts.
What kind of hard life did this child live in the past?
